---
title: Configuration
description: Config fields, YAML keys and option helpers for Cache
---

## YAML Configuration Example

`Config` has no YAML tags, so the keys in your file are the Go field names, spelled and capitalised
exactly as in the table below. `DefaultTTL` works. `defaultTTL` and `default_ttl` are silently
ignored, and the field keeps its default.

```yaml title="config.yaml"
extensions:
  cache:
    Driver: inmemory           # inmemory works; redis and memcached aren't implemented yet
    DefaultTTL: 10m            # used when Set gets a TTL of 0
    MaxSize: 50000             # entries, 0 for no limit
    CleanupInterval: 1m        # how often expired entries are swept
    MaxKeySize: 250            # bytes, 0 for no limit
    MaxValueSize: 1048576      # bytes (1 MiB), 0 for no limit
    Prefix: "orders:"          # added to every key
```

The extension reads `extensions.cache` first and falls back to a top-level `cache` key.

The final config is built in layers: `DefaultConfig()`, then the file, then any field you set in
code with an option. Fields you leave out of the file keep their defaults, and a plain
`cache.NewExtension()` picks up every key in the block. One case the loader can't tell apart: if you
set a field in code to the same value as its default, the file wins for that field.

Forge reads `config.yaml` only when `EnableConfigAutoDiscovery` is on. `forge.DefaultAppConfig()`
turns it on, but a bare `forge.AppConfig{...}` literal leaves it off, so set it yourself or pass your
own `ConfigManager`.

## Programmatic Configuration

```go
ext := cache.NewExtension(
	cache.WithDriver("inmemory"),
	cache.WithDefaultTTL(10*time.Minute),
	cache.WithMaxSize(50000),
	cache.WithPrefix("myapp:"),
)
```

Or hand over a complete config. Start from `DefaultConfig()`, because `WithConfig` replaces every
field, and a zero `MaxKeySize` or `MaxValueSize` turns that limit off:

```go
cfg := cache.DefaultConfig()
cfg.DefaultTTL = 10 * time.Minute
cfg.Prefix = "myapp:"

ext := cache.NewExtensionWithConfig(cfg)
```

## Config Struct Reference

### `Config`

Source: `extensions/cache/config.go`

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Driver` | `string` | `"inmemory"` | `"inmemory"`, `"redis"` or `"memcached"`. Only `inmemory` is implemented |
| `URL` | `string` | `""` | Connection string. Validation requires it for `redis` and `memcached` |
| `DefaultTTL` | `time.Duration` | `5m` | Used when `Set` gets a TTL of `0` |
| `MaxSize` | `int` | `10000` | Maximum number of entries. `0` means no limit |
| `CleanupInterval` | `time.Duration` | `1m` | How often expired entries are swept |
| `MaxKeySize` | `int` | `250` | Maximum key size in bytes. `0` means no limit |
| `MaxValueSize` | `int` | `1048576` | Maximum value size in bytes (1 MiB). `0` means no limit |
| `Prefix` | `string` | `""` | Added to every key |
| `ConnectionPoolSize` | `int` | `10` | Reserved for the network drivers. Nothing reads it yet |
| `ConnectionTimeout` | `time.Duration` | `5s` | Reserved for the network drivers. Nothing reads it yet |
| `ReadTimeout` | `time.Duration` | `3s` | Reserved for the network drivers. Nothing reads it yet |
| `WriteTimeout` | `time.Duration` | `3s` | Reserved for the network drivers. Nothing reads it yet |
| `RequireConfig` | `bool` | `false` | When `true`, `Register` fails if neither `extensions.cache` nor `cache` is in your config |

## Validation

`Register` calls `Config.Validate()` and fails when:

- `Driver` is empty, or isn't `inmemory`, `redis` or `memcached`
- `URL` is empty for a driver other than `inmemory`
- `DefaultTTL` is negative (returns `ErrInvalidTTL`)
- `MaxKeySize` or `MaxValueSize` is negative

Passing validation with `redis` or `memcached` isn't enough to start: building the service then fails
with "not yet implemented".

## Option Helpers

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `WithDriver(driver string)` | Sets `Driver` |
| `WithURL(url string)` | Sets `URL` |
| `WithDefaultTTL(ttl time.Duration)` | Sets `DefaultTTL` |
| `WithMaxSize(size int)` | Sets `MaxSize` |
| `WithPrefix(prefix string)` | Sets `Prefix` |
| `WithConnectionPoolSize(size int)` | Sets `ConnectionPoolSize` |
| `WithRequireConfig(require bool)` | Sets `RequireConfig` |
| `WithConfig(config Config)` | Replaces the whole config |

There are no options for `CleanupInterval`, `MaxKeySize`, `MaxValueSize` or the timeouts. Set those
in YAML or through `WithConfig`.
